FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Culinary Creations Catering Services specializes in providing high-quality catering and food preparation for a variety of events, including corporate gatherings, weddings, and private parties. We pride ourselves on using only fresh, locally sourced ingredients and maintaining rigorous food safety standards in compliance with the FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) and local health regulations. 

Our operations include menu planning, food preparation, on-site setup, service, and cleanup, utilizing commercial-grade equipment and temperature-controlled vehicles to ensure food safety and quality. Additionally, we conduct regular staff training on food handling procedures to minimize any food safety risks and maintain operational excellence. We believe in transparent ingredient sourcing, keeping detailed records of supplier certifications, and implementing best practices to manage food safety effectively.

Our commitment to quality and compliance helps us build lasting relationships with our clients, whether they are hosting intimate gatherings or large events. We continually evaluate and enhance our risk management strategies to ensure we meet industry standards while providing exceptional service.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in any activities that violate FDA FSMA or local food safety regulations and confirms full compliance with all applicable standards. We maintain meticulous records of ingredient sourcing and supplier certifications, ensuring proper documentation is always available. Additionally, we routinely provide proof of compliance with local health regulations, demonstrating our commitment to food safety and quality.
